description: Land Acquisition - Riloluwa and Epaladeniya, Narammala D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that specific parcels of land are needed for a public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land lots with their boundaries, extents, and location details. The content focuses exclusively on land matters (acquisition of property) without any government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories, making it a clear Land Gazette.
